_readme: Hand-entered licensed figure (model v5.3): the CoStar average apartment cap rate for the San Francisco Bay Area, used for non-commercial purposes while a permission request is pending. Update it after each CoStar quarterly multifamily report (cap and signals.cap: iso = last day of the quarter, date = e.g. "Q4 2026", detail = one plain sentence). The daily workflow opens a GitHub issue as a reminder when the figure is more than about four months old. Delete the value to fall back to the free price-to-rent measure. Apartment vacancy, rent on new leases (Apartment List) and months of supply (Redfin) are now downloaded automatically.

cap.detail: Average for all San Francisco Bay Area apartment buildings (CoStar), up from 5.5% a year ago. Newer, high-end buildings sell at about 4.25–4.65%, which is below the Treasury yield.
